paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.45% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+1.46%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-2.12%). Brent crude changed -11.28% to 104.37. Gold changed +1.42% to 3,954.1001. Bitcoin changed -2.02% to 76,667.0703. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.894%, a relative move of -0.71%. Among the firms tracked, US Oil Fund (ETF) (-7.08%) and Equinor (-6.87%) moved the most.
